author: Corridor Crew
description: From the World of John Wick: Ballerina has some serious stunt work, especially in relation to the scenes involving the flamethrower "The Dragon" and setting the bad guys on fire. Big props to the fire specialist stunt team, coordinated by Jayson Dumenigo, and huge props to Chau Naumanova (@chaunaumanova) for delivering one of the best fire stunts ever.
title: Is this THE BEST fire stunt EVER?
